title: Close a rigid telescoping-lid box over its product without wedging the lid
instruction: Close the box: seat the lid fully over the base with the product inside, square and without wedging it. Leave the box where it is.
context: Hand packers (SOC 53-7064, packers and packagers, hand, about 0.6M US jobs, BLS) close two-piece rigid boxes (instrument, electronics and gift boxes) by hand all shift. The lid fits over the base with only a few mm to spare each side, so it has to be brought down level and in line: a lid tilted or yawed by a degree or two catches on the base's rim and wedges half on, and a hard push dents the skirt. The job ends with the lid fully seated, the box square and left where it was packed.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; the table top is the reference height. x points forward from the line through the two arm bases, y to the left of the midpoint between them, z up; arm bases at y +30.5 cm and -30.5 cm. (1) Base: rigid two-piece box base, 2.0 mm greyboard wrapped in black paper, open top, 70 (x) x 114 (y) x 40 (z) mm outside (66 x 110 mm inside), 0.05 kg, standing on the table at x 330 mm, y -70 mm. (2) Product: a pocket laser distance meter in its hard case, yellow and black, 55 x 105 x 28 mm, 0.12 kg (sizes est from catalogue figures for this class of instrument; measure the real item), lying flat in the base, long side along y, its top 30 mm over the table, 10 mm below the base's rim. (3) Lid: the matching telescoping lid, 2.0 mm greyboard wrapped in black paper, a top panel with a 34 mm skirt below it, 79 x 123 mm outside, 75 x 119 mm inside, 36 mm tall, 0.05 kg. Its inside is 2.5 mm larger than the base's outside on every side (est: measure the real box). It stands top panel up, skirt down, on the table at x 330 mm, y -290 mm, its long side along y. (4) Seated means the lid's top panel rests on the base's rim: the lid's top outer face 42 mm over the table (40 mm of base plus the 2 mm panel), the skirt over the base's walls by 34 mm, its rim 6 mm over the table. Friction 0.45 board on board and on the table (est), 0.5 board on gripper. Nothing else is on the table.
scoring: End state, read at the last step from the poses of the base, lid and product and both grippers. Seated: the lid's top outer face within 1.5 mm of 42 mm over the table. Square: the lid's yaw within 1.5 degrees of the base's and its top face tilted under 1.0 degree. Centred: the lid's centre within 3.5 mm of the base's (top view). Engaged: the lid upright (tilt under 10 degrees), its centre within 8 mm of the base's and its skirt's lowest point 10 mm or more below the base's rim. On the base: the lid upright within 30 degrees, its centre within 25 mm of the base's and its lowest point 4 mm or more over the table. Box still: the base within 20 mm of where it began (top view), on the table within 3 mm and tilted under 2 degrees. Hands off: on every step of the last 1 s both grippers' finger zones are 30 mm or more from the base, lid and product, and over that 1 s each part moves under 1 mm and turns under 0.3 degrees. Score 0 if at any time the lid or base falls more than 10 mm below the table top or the product's centre leaves the base's inside, and 0 unless hands off and box still. Otherwise: 1.0 seated, square and centred; 0.5 engaged but not 1.0; 0.25 the lid on the base otherwise; 0 anything else (a lid on the table, upside down or off the base). Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0. Success: 1.0 held for 1 s. Doing nothing scores 0. In a real trial: seated, calipers or a steel rule from the table to the lid's top (1.5 mm); square, a try-square on the lid's side against the base and a phone level on the lid's top (1.0 degree); centred, a feeler gauge in the gap on each side; engaged, a rule against the skirt's rim; box still, a pencil outline and a rule; hands off, a 30 mm spacer against each hand and 30 fps video. Also in a real trial: score 0 if a wall is dented or creased more than 2 mm (a 2 mm feeler).
fidelity: Rigid bodies: the boards are 2 mm rigid plates, so nothing flexes, dents or tears (a real trial adds a dent check). The 2.5 mm play per side, the friction, all box and product sizes and masses are estimates to measure on the real box. The product is a solid block of its outer size and mass. The hard case, paper wrap and foam of a real pack are not modelled.
reset_notes: Lay the instrument in the base, long side along y, base at x 330, y -70 mm. Stand the lid top up at x 330, y -290 mm, long side along y. Replace a box whose walls are dented or creased more than 2 mm; check the 2.5 mm play each side with a feeler.
